text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The more I ran in training and races, the 
more often I found myself wondering about 
that.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Some days my stride would be shallower 
than expected, or I'd kick off my spurt 
too early and run out of stamina along the 
way.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It was just the tiniest sense of unease. 
And yet, despite being so slight—
(Crack-crack-crack...!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I felt as though this body called "Sakura 
Chiyono O" was beginning to crumble away 
piece by piece.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Mornin'. Starting today at training camp, 
I'm seriously gonna become the strongest 
ever!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Haha, so annoying. You're not the only one 
who's gonna improve at training camp, ya 
know.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Must be nice.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I'll fall apart even more if I 
keep running any longer...

The summer training camp season has 
arrived once again.

In front of the school gate, a line of 
Umamusume had formed, waiting for the bus 
to the training camp. Among them was 
Sakura Chiyono O.

However, her expression was stiff and 
tense, as though she were nervous about 
something...
choice_data_list:
...Chiyono O, let's do our best at summer 
training camp!

...Chiyono O, let's do our best at summer 
training camp!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Trainer?! Y-Yes! Training camp is 
the ultimate opportunity for growth, after 
all!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, I did some research! 
On effective training methods!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Umm, well... I was thinking I'd focus on 
strength training instead of running this 
time!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: As for that running... umm.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"I want to save time trials for the second 
half of the camp so we can look forward to 
seeing how much we've grown!!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Umm... is that not okay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Is that true?!

Actually, preparing for this training 
camp, I had also devoured various research 
papers, planning to incorporate them into 
a separate regimen.

Among those, I had even prepared a special 
menu for Umamusume past their peak, but...

"...If she doesn't desire it yet, it might 
be cruel of us to propose it ourselves."
choice_data_list:
(Perhaps once that desire takes root 
within her.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...? Trainer?
choice_data_list:
I'll put together a training menu based on 
that direction.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...! Thank you very much! I look forward 
to working with you at the training camp 
too!
(Patter-patter-patter!)

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! Before you head to the training 
camp lodge, could we get just a quick 
quote from you!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Please!! I'm sure the rest of the world is 
dying to know as well!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
We are terribly sorry. Please refrain from 
conducting interviews at this time, and we 
kindly ask for your cooperation...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Whoa, there are so many reporters here...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Are you all here to interview the Big 
Three? Those three really do draw all the 
attention, don't they!

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Please, we just want to hear 
Maruzensky-san's own voice on this!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey~ now, you troublemakers! Be nice to 
Miss Tazuna, or no treats for you, okay?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky-san!! Is it true that you won 
by a whopping seven lengths in your first 
mock race in a long time!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
What is the reason for your comeback? Is 
it because formidable rivals known as the 
'Big Three' have emerged!?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Umm, well~...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: It's a se-cret♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Our showdown is this autumn! Bye-bye♪
(Vroom vroom... VROOOOOM!)

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Wait, Maruzen-san?! Maruzen-saaan!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Man... Maruzensky's as amazing as ever. I 
thought her peak was already behind her, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
She's a legend, after all. She's 
definitely on a whole other level compared 
to ordinary Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...All these people gathered here, they 
all came for Maruzen-san.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...Maruzen-san is trying to keep her 
promise to me."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I need to do my best too.
